about.title: One home for every fandom.
about.intro: FandomVerse brings anime, gaming, movies, TV, K-Pop, comics, and manga into one fan-first place to explore stories, characters, media, events, and collectibles.
about.mission: Make it easier for fans to discover new stories, revisit the worlds they love, and find the people and moments that make each fandom special.

website.title: Seven fandom hubs
website.description: Browse category-specific articles, character profiles, galleries, trailers, podcasts, events, and merchandise.

website.title: A fan-first experience
website.description: Save favorites, add session-only notes, explore curated search results, and switch between dark and light themes.

website.title: Verse Assistant
website.description: Get quick answers from a local, rule-based FAQ bot—no live AI service or account is needed.

website.title: Local-first demo
website.description: The catalogue is pre-populated JSON. Favorites stay in your browser, notes are session-only, and sign-in and checkout are demo interfaces.

team.description: Organizes the pre-populated stories, character profiles, and fandom facts so each hub is easy to explore.
Highlights conventions, fan gatherings, releases, and community moments across all seven categories.
